The company has a history of achieving benchmark quality, customer-centric approach, robust engineering, in-house research, uncompromising business ethics, timeless values, and transparency. It went public in 2006 through an IPO that was oversubscribed a record 127 times. Sobha Limited operates in 27 cities and 14 states across India, with a focus on Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Kerala, Chennai, Pune, Coimbatore, Mysore, and GIFT City. The company has developed over 140 million square feet of land and employs approximately 4,121 people as of September 2024. Sobha Limited's mission is to challenge existing norms and standards in real estate to enrich communities and societies at large, and its vision is to become the most trusted real estate developer both regionally and globally.. With three decades of glorious experience in creating interiors of palaces and masterpieces in the Middle-East, Mr. Menon founded SOBHA Limited in 1995 with a clear vision to transform the way people perceive quality. Today, SOBHA is the most trusted brand and only backward integrated real estate player in the country. Since inception, the Company has always strived for benchmark quality, customer centric approach, robust engineering, in-house research, uncompromising business ethics, timeless values and transparency in all spheres of business conduct, which have contributed in making it a preferred real estate brand in India. In 2006, SOBHA went public through its initial public offering, an event that created history when the issue got oversubscribed a record 126 times. Product & Service Portfolio: Sobha Limited is a luxury real estate company in India that offers a range of products and services. The company's business areas include real estate development, residential property development, commercial property development, interior design and manufacturing, and construction contracting. Sobha provides luxury residential apartments, residential villas and duplexes, commercial real estate projects, interior design services, glazing and metal works manufacturing, and concrete products manufacturing. The company also offers contracting business services comprising design, civil and structural works, MEP, interior fit-outs, aluminum and glazing systems, and landscaping. Sobha's manufacturing segment includes glass, glazing, and concrete products used in its own builds. The company operates through the Real Estate, and Contractual and Manufacturing segments, with a focus on developing, selling, managing, and operating residential and commercial real estate.. # Sobha Ltd.
